title: Wire scope validation into task loop
description: In task-loop.service.ts, run scope validation as an additional gate after quality gates. Scope violations = gate failure. Revert violating file changes via git checkout before retry.
acceptance_criteria: Scope validation runs after quality gates
Scope violations treated as gate failures
Violating file changes reverted via git checkout
Violations logged in loop iteration record
Retry includes scope violation details in fix context
